units.source_text: 虽然京都没有遭到空袭，但我却看见了这样一个场面：

en.t: Although Kyoto was not bombed, I did witness a scene like this:

units.source_text: 有一回，奉工厂之命出差，

en.t: On one occasion, while traveling on factory business,

units.source_text: 一个职工手拿飞机部件的订货单前去大阪总厂时正好遇上空袭，

en.t: a worker was carrying an order form for aircraft parts to the main factory in Osaka when he happened to be caught in an air raid,

units.source_text: 他的肠子露了出来，被人用担架抬走了。

en.t: his intestines were exposed, and he was carried away on a stretcher.
